decisions.reason: After another year without clear evidence that this distant service meets aspirations, its weak fit with our maritime resource base makes redeployment to core and newer compliance offers the more likely choice.

The maritime education programme fits our established training capabilities and its quick expansion to six partner institutions suggests performance at or above early aspirations, so available slack supports further scaling.

The emissions monitoring and compliance service achieved a clear deadline-critical result across all in-scope vessels, placing it above aspiration and squarely within our strategic move toward compliance and environmental support.

Even with limited market proof so far, the emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into our core software and strengthens our digital compliance offering, which justifies continued retention while results develop.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool remains somewhat uncertain on uptake, but its close complementarity with our software and compliance services makes continued trial preferable to immediate withdrawal.
